summary: @servicetitan/titan-chatbot-ui-anvil2 preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727KB payload
details: The package declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs is obfuscator.io-style obfuscated (identifiers like _0x488df8, _0x52943e, per-function string maps) and constructs a URL of the form https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/... to download the Bun runtime binary, then invokes execFileSync(bunPath, [join(D, 'math_init.js')]). math_init.js is a 727KB single-line file with a shuffled string-array decoder (rotate function, large char-map array) — canonical obfuscator.io output. Installing the package therefore auto-fetches an alternate language runtime and uses it to execute a heavily obfuscated sibling payload under a runtime that Node-oriented tooling does not inspect. A React chatbot UI library has no legitimate reason to fetch a second language runtime at install time or to ship a large obfuscated blob executed by that runtime. The wrapper and payload have no relationship to the package's stated UI-component purpose.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
